ballpit.name: Physics Ballpit
ballpit.desc: A high-performance interactive physics playground using elastic circle collision.
ballpit.why: Understanding gravity and collision logic is fundamental for game development and advanced UI interactions.
ballpit.guide: Interact with the balls using your mouse to observe force distribution and friction decay.

liquid-chrome.name: Liquid Chrome
liquid-chrome.desc: An elite metallic shader effect using Three.js and custom GLSL noise displacement.
liquid-chrome.why: Advanced shaders elevate the aesthetic quality of a site, providing a premium, high-end feel.
liquid-chrome.guide: Use this as a background for hero sections. It scales perfectly to any resolution via WebGL.

click-spark.name: Click Spark
click-spark.desc: A vibrant particle emitter that responds to user interaction with physics-based gravity.
click-spark.why: Micro-interactions keep users engaged and provide immediate feedback for their actions.
click-spark.guide: Click anywhere in the area to spawn particles. Observe how they fade out over their lifecycle.

glitch-text.name: Glitch Text
glitch-text.desc: A high-speed character scrambling effect using randomized ASCII iteration.
glitch-text.why: Cyberpunk and tech-heavy aesthetics rely on glitch effects to communicate a high-velocity digital feel.
glitch-text.guide: Best used for titles and core headings. Adjustable speed via the timing interval.

blur-text.name: Blur Text
blur-text.desc: A staggered, smooth Gaussian blur reveal effect for focus-driven titles.
blur-text.why: Staggered reveals focus the user's attention on specific words, improving retention.
blur-text.topics: Framer Motion, Staggered Delays, Opacity Transitions
blur-text.guide: Change the split logic from words to characters for a more granular 'typing' feel.

halqa-qr.name: Halqa QR Generator
halqa-qr.desc: Functional, high-fidelity QR generator with custom accent mapping and mobile conversion CTA.
halqa-qr.why: QR codes are essential for bridging the gap between physical and digital experiences in modern apps.
halqa-qr.guide: Input your URL and select a brand-matching color. The generated SVG is export-ready.

shiny-text.name: Shiny Text
shiny-text.desc: A liquid metallic shimmer effect that glides over your text.
shiny-text.why: Glossy effects create a premium, apple-like aesthetic that feels polished and state-of-the-art.
shiny-text.topics: CSS Background Clip, Keyframe Animations, Gradients
shiny-text.guide: Works best on heavy, bold fonts. Adjust the gradient stops to change the 'sheen' sharpness.

aurora-bg.name: Aurora Background
aurora-bg.desc: A living, breathing northern lights simulation for immersive hero sections.
aurora-bg.why: Abstract, slow-moving backgrounds reduce cognitive load while maintaining visual interest.
aurora-bg.topics: Radial Gradients, CSS Filters, Spatial Math
aurora-bg.guide: Set this as a fixed background. Use with high-contrast text for maximum readability.

magnet-btn.name: Magnet Button
magnet-btn.desc: An organic interaction that pulls toward the user's cursor.
magnet-btn.why: Magnetic interactions increase the 'clickability' of CTAs by providing tactile-like visual feedback.
magnet-btn.topics: Proximity Detection, Spring Physics, Framer Motion
magnet-btn.guide: Wrap any button in the magnet container to instantly upgrade its UX feel.

apple-bento.name: Adaptive Bento
apple-bento.desc: A sophisticated asymmetrical feature grid inspired by premium design languages.
apple-bento.why: Bento grids are the gold standard for presenting complex feature sets in a clean, logical hierarchy.
apple-bento.topics: CSS Grid, Fractional Units, Responsive Layouts
apple-bento.guide: Add new items by defining their span values in the grid container.
